name: The Spa Hotel
accommodation: Rooms including sea-view family and twin rooms, plus self-catering units The Outlook and Treetops
suitableFor: Couples, families, dog owners and surfers
beachAccess: A stone's throw from Saltburn beach
confirmedFeatures: Spa treatments, open-top terrace, all-day food, EV charging, luggage storage, event venue
overview: A hotel on Saltburn Bank with wide views over Huntcliff and the sea, a stone's throw from the beach and pier. Many rooms face the sea, and there are also two self-catering units. Food is served all day, there is a terrace for warmer weather, and dogs and surfers are both welcomed.
surfTripFit: You can see the break from the terrace and walk down to the beach in minutes.
